title: Onboard Stellar-13B v1.1: perf metadata, versioning, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Onboard Stellar-13B v1.1 into the model registry with curated performance metadata, updated versioning fields, and automated changelog generation. Motivation: Stellar-13B v1.1 includes improved attention kernels and a small tokenizer fix; this PR ensures the model is discoverable by the runtime and that perf profiles drive serving configuration (batching/kv-cache/quantization advisories). This change also extends our changelog automation to include 'model-metadata' category entries so releases surface model onboarding to product and infra teams. Summary of changes (commits and intent): 1) Add v1.1 metadata and canonical model id (commit: add stellar 13b v1.1 metadata and tags) 2) Add perf profiles generated from lab runs (commit: add perf_profiles for stellar-13b v1.1) 3) Update registry index and versioning tests (commit: bump registry index and add version validation) 4) Wire changelog automation to include model-metadata changes and ensure generated release notes include perf highlights (commit: extend changelog generator to pick up model-metadata category) Files changed (high level): models/stellar/13b/v1.1/metadata.yaml (model metadata, version, architectures, tokenizer hash, checksum), models/stellar/13b/v1.1/perf_profiles.json (latency/throughput profiles for common sequence lengths and recommended serving configs), registry/index.yaml (added entry for stellar-13b:v1.1), scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py (automation: include model-metadata and perf summary), tests/model_registry/test_onboard_stellar.py (unit + integration mocks for metadata validation), docs/models/stellar.md (public-facing notes and perf summary), ci/workflows/model-registry.yml (added job to run perf-profile lint). Commits: - feat: add stellar-13b v1.1 metadata and tags - perf: add perf_profiles/steller-13b v1.1 (64/128/512 seq) - test: add registry index and version validation tests - ci: run perf-profile lint and changelog smoke test - docs: add model page and perf summary Review conversation highlights: - Luca Romano: "Please include the tokenizer checksum and the quantization recommendations for int8/4bit in perf_profiles.json; we'll use that for Dedicated autoscaling routes." Author reply (Maya): "Added tokenizer checksum and quant recommendation table; kept separate field for recommended kernels per hardware." - Priya Singh: "Changelog automation looks good but please ensure it doesn't duplicate entries when multiple metadata files change in one PR." Author reply: "Added dedupe logic to generate_changelog.py and unit tests to cover multi-file PRs." - Noah Kim: "CI flaked on the perf-profile lint, reran and it passed. Can we add a smoke test to the workflow to validate changelog diff generation?" Author reply: "Added small smoke test and pinned the test data used in CI to avoid flakiness." CI details: Initial run: build/pass, unit-tests/pass, perf-profile-lint/fail (missing checksum) -> author pushed fix -> rerun all -> all checks pass. Merge: Squash and merge on 2026-02-25 after approvals from all reviewers. Post-merge tasks: - Registry webhook picks up new model and triggers internal model ingestion job. - Docs site auto-build includes models/stellar.md. - Release notes generated (automated) and included in weekly release email. Notes for ops and on-call: No breaking changes to serving runtime; perf profiles include recommended fallback to lighter quantized variants on constrained capacity. If serving latency deviates >20% from profile for 5m, alert perf-team (ENG-4132). Links: Linear ENG-4132 (onboarding), PM-284 (product announcement), CI run: https://ci.internal/redwood/103999, Changelog generator ticket: ENG-4180 (follow-up to improve perf summary granularity).

release_notes: Added Stellar-13B v1.1 to the model registry. Includes: canonical model metadata, perf profiles with serving recommendations (latency/throughput for 64/128/512 sequences), tokenizer checksum, and automated changelog entry. No breaking changes. Recommended: use int8 quantized variant for cost-sensitive Dedicated deployments; fallback rules included.
notes_for_ops: Perf profiles include recommended batch sizes and kernel hints. If observed p99 latency >20% of profile for 5m, page perf-oncall (ENG-4132). Changelog automation will create a model-metadata entry in release notes; remove duplicates if you perform manual edits.
